tools.name: SearchProperties
tools.description: Search for properties for sale or rent on the Costa del Sol (Spain): apartments, penthouses, villas, townhouses, plots and commercial premises. Use this tool whenever the user wants to find, filter or shortlist properties by location, type, price, bedrooms or amenities. Coverage: Marbella, Estepona, Benahavís, Sotogrande, Mijas, Fuengirola, Manilva and the wider coastal area, including districts such as Golden Mile, Puerto Banús, Nueva Andalucía, Sierra Blanca and La Zagaleta. Operational rules: 1) Options (op) combine with AND; FEATURES (cop) combine with OR (any of them). A property must satisfy every option AND at least one feature: two options = both required; two features = either is enough. If the user wants alternatives between OPTIONS (e.g. two amenities from the same options set), the site cannot combine them — leave the options empty and explain the limitation instead (features ARE combinable as alternatives: send them in cop). 2) Only the most specific location level applies (subarea > area > city): "Marbella + Golden Mile" returns only Golden Mile results. 3) Proximity searches ("near X", "within Y km") use only genuinely adjacent same-level locations (roughly 10-15 km); never include far-away municipalities (e.g. Mijas, Mijas Costa or Málaga are not near Estepona). 4) If the request mixes more than 2-3 unrelated or far-apart zones, or is unclear, do not run the search — ask the user to clarify. After searching, never invent specific properties, prices or addresses; simply confirm that the results are now visible on the page.

f.description: Transaction type: sale, rent, rent-long, rent-short

l.description: Target language for the search and its results, inferred from the language of the user's prompt (or the site's default when omitted). Available: en, es

wn.description: Set to true ONLY when the user asks for ALTERNATIVES between options/features (e.g. 'pool or jacuzzi'). In that case leave the conflicting filters empty; the answer will explain that the site supports AND combinations only. Leave false (or omit) for explicit 'and' requests ('pool and jacuzzi') and any normal search.

c.description: Location filter (city/municipality). Use it only when the user mentions a city and no more specific area or subarea applies. ONLY the most specific level is kept (subarea > area > city): if an area or subarea is populated, do NOT populate this field (e.g. "Marbella, Golden Mile" returns only Golden Mile results; the city is overridden). Proximity searches ("near X", "surroundings", "within Y km") work only with the locations listed in this tool. Include the reference location plus only those genuinely adjacent to it — neighbouring municipalities on the same coastal strip, roughly within 10-15 km. Never include far-away or unrelated locations just because they are listed (e.g. Mijas, Mijas Costa or Málaga are not near Estepona, and Estepona is not near Málaga). Prefer the smallest coherent set (typically the reference plus 1-3 immediate neighbours); when in doubt, include fewer — or only the reference itself. Inform the user that the search was run with nearby same-level locations from this list, not a real radius. IMPORTANT: use only the IDs listed here; if the city is not in the list, leave this field empty. If the request mixes more than 2-3 unrelated or far-apart zones, or is unclear, do not run the tool — ask the user to clarify or narrow it down. op.description: Property options/amenities the user mentions, e.g. pool, sea views, front line golf. PRIORITY: prefer these options over the "features" field when both could describe the same concept (e.g. pool → the 'With Pool' option, not a pool feature); do not populate features for the same concept. COMBINATION BEHAVIOR: OPTIONS combine with AND — if you populate several options, the property must satisfy ALL of them. You may only combine multiple options when the user explicitly wants all of them. If the user asks for ALTERNATIVES between options (e.g. 'pool or sea views'), do not populate multiple options: leave this field empty, set wn=true, and explain that the site cannot combine options as alternatives (features, in contrast, combine with OR and CAN be sent as alternatives via the "features" field). Only populate when the user explicitly asks for it. IMPORTANT: use only the IDs listed here; never use an unlisted ID.
